prioritized_backlog.name: Monolithic Tower-42 Galois Field Multiplier Inlining
prioritized_backlog.hypothesis: Replacing the 63-Toffoli standard Karatsuba multiplier with the 42-Toffoli Galois extension tensor GF(2^12) ~= GF(8)[v]/(v^4+v+1) directly within the monolithic Kickmix compiled circuit lowers dynamic Toffolis by ~19% without expanding active qubit count beyond 889Q.
prioritized_backlog.mathematical_derivation: GF(2^12) represented as degree-4 extension of GF(8). Karatsuba over degree 4 requires 9 products in GF(8); evaluation at 7 points in GF(8) requires 7 products in GF(8). Each GF(8) multiplication uses 6 Toffolis via Mastrovito bilinear form. Total: 7 * 6 = 42 Toffolis vs 63 Toffolis baseline.
critical_constraints: Circuit must strictly maintain Q <= 900 ceiling (target: <= 889)
Zero Z_POW gates permitted in DAG
Full Kickmix 256-shot semantic test must produce 0 value errors and 0 phase errors
Reversible scratch cleanup must leave zero dirty ancillas

prioritized_backlog.name: Syndrome Register In-Place Wire Reuse
prioritized_backlog.hypothesis: Syndrome bits are read-only after the disparity calculation in each decoding round; uncomputing intermediate disparity registers and reusing their allocated wires for subsequent error locator evaluations reduces active qubit width from 889Q towards 740Q.
prioritized_backlog.mathematical_derivation: Liveness analysis on the 889Q DAG reveals 149 syndrome/disparity ancilla wires have disjoint lifetimes after round t=18. Under linear register reuse, wires W_i with dead intervals [t_end(W_i), infty) can be remapped without quantum cloning.
critical_constraints: Must formally prove zero information leakage from unreclaimed registers
Must verify all 70 Reed-Solomon decoding error weight branches
Must prevent Bennett pebbling memory expansion traps

prioritized_backlog.name: J=7 Packed Pebble Angle Compilation on Verified Factorization
prioritized_backlog.hypothesis: Batching rotation synthesis across J=7 orbital pairs instead of J=5 reduces angle circuit count from 15 to 11 while maintaining per-circuit qubit ceiling Q_angle <= 128 and energy error e2 <= 0.020 mHa.
prioritized_backlog.mathematical_derivation: With L=9 rank blocks and J=7 orbital batching, ceil(76 / 7) = 11 angle circuits. State preparation QROM addresses contract from 15 to 11 stages, saving 4 state prep cycles (~1,800 Toffolis).
critical_constraints: Maximum angle circuit width must stay strictly <= 128 qubits
Angle circuits must contain strictly 0 T-like gates
Energy error 2 must strictly remain <= 0.02000000 mHa

prioritized_backlog.name: Single-Rotation Seed Table Factoring & Lawson 58Q Lowering
prioritized_backlog.hypothesis: Lowering the mathematically proven 58Q Lawson minimax polynomial circuit into a concrete .kmb binary, combined with sharing the rotation synthesis stage for the seed table, drops billed cost from 93,325 to <= 83,071.
prioritized_backlog.mathematical_derivation: Horner polynomial evaluation with 4 subintervals on x in [1, 3133452] allows in-place carry folding into vacated exponent bits, saving 4 ancilla qubits (Q: 62 -> 58). Single-rotation seed table factoring synthesizes 1 rotation per interval instead of 2.
critical_constraints: Circuit must compile to valid .kmb binary format
Numerical error over all 200,540,928 points must stay <= 2^-10
